---
title: "title-slides"
subtitle: "Carrying a title across continuation slides"
format: revealjs
filters:
  - title-slides
title-slides: true
---

## Introduction

A slide started by a `##` heading is titled, as always.

- the heading is written once
- it is what the extension carries onward

---

This slide was started by a `---`, with no heading of its own.

It is titled anyway: the extension carried `Introduction` onto it.

---

And so is this one. The title keeps coming until a new `##` appears.

## Writing it

Two keys in the frontmatter:

``` yaml
filters:
  - title-slides
title-slides: true
```

---

Continuations of `Writing it` now carry that title instead.

# Details

A `#` section slide clears the carried title.

---

So this slide, right after the section, has no title at all.

## Identifiers

Each continuation gets its own identifier, so links keep working.

---

And carries a class you can style or hide:

``` css
.title-slides-continuation h2 { opacity: 0.6; }
```
